theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mw_tfa_continuous_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Integrable β ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (g x - β x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal δ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
